priorEvidence.reason: Probe incorrectly expected a permission prompt for a safe project read; expectation corrected, no permission bypass introduced.
Title append invalidated action source during save approval.
Same parameters and surface; new session_info title changed leaf digest and apply returned 409.
17 tests, 15 passed and 2 failed before the fix.
Earlier successful workflow; final probe additionally waits for server runtime idle.

fix: Only trailing linear session_info records are normalized in action identity. Parameter reads still use the actual leaf; sibling branches, other records and changed parameters invalidate old actions. Stale approval cancels its live pending run; simultaneous replies are consumed once.
limitations: One Windows Electron workflow with Flash and JSON files; not a full device/model/permission/format matrix.
The read fixture uses keys from the generated surface. Most interactions use visible controls; initial session/tool/permission setup uses HTTP.
Screenshots were inspected. The final screenshot can precede client SSE idle reconciliation even though the server was idle; no assertion of a completed client status indicator is made.
Assistant prose and the auto-generated chat title contain initial values and are not reactive UI state. Model wording about read approval was imprecise; semantic review remains open.
No CI, release packaging, external publication or independent human acceptance was performed.
